To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the model driven development of MAS is possible and can be achieved with the O MaSE methodology.
O MaSE methodology can be used for model driven development agent based CPS and that agentTool III is a suitable tool for implementation of agent based systems.

model driven development of CPS using O MaSE is a promising approach to achieve high level of automation, intelligence, flexibility, adaptability, reconfigurability, and security of CPS, and that O MaSE provides the necessary support to develop agent based CPS.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: 1. Definition of the software process for the model driven development of the agent based CPS using O MaSE. 2. Definition of a set of agent classes for
model driven development of CPS based on agent oriented software engineering and the application of this approach in the development of pilot reactor as a CPS.

the development of agent based software systems and their application in CPS and the Internet of Things, as well as the development of software engineering processes for the development of such systems and their application.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed model driven approach is a promising solution to the development of agent based Cyber Physical Systems.
the proposed approach is a feasible and effective approach for model driven development agent based CPS.
the suggested model driven software engineering process for agent based CPS is suitable for developing agent based CPS in a systematic way and is applicable for a wide range of applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed approach is suitable for development of agent based distributed CPS.
the suggested approach provides a systematic way for model driven development and deployment of agent based CPS.

the model driven development of MAS is an important approach to the development of agent based systems, and that O MaSE is a suitable methodology for model driven development and implementation of agent based CPS, and that the agentTool III can be used for the development of agent systems in general and for agent based systems in particular.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the suggested approach can be successfully used for model driven development, design and implementation of agent based CPS.
the O MaSE methodology can be used as a software process model to support model driven development of complex agent based CPS.
model driven development is an effective approach to the development of agent based systems.
